card.name: Apply after topical-use-only warnings
card.fires_on: The word Apply (or apply) starting an instruction right after a 'not for oral, ophthalmic, or intravaginal use' warning on skin products. Also weaker on 'by' or 'to' in phrases like 'as determined by the physician'.

modes.label: Apply a thin layer
modes.description: The verb Apply opening the directions for gels and creams after a not-for-oral-use line.
modes.example: TWYNEO is for topical use only. TWYNEO is not for oral, ophthalmic, or intravaginal use.<< Apply>> a thin layer of TWYNEO

modes.label: by / to before a person or guideline
modes.description: Linking words like by or to that lead into who or what sets the action, such as the physician or guidelines.
modes.example: administer all immunizations according<< to>> immunization guidelines at least 4 weeks

card.writes: Promotes odd mixed-language tokens and suppresses 'decision' words, so there is no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It lights up on the word Apply at the start of directions for skin gels and creams.
